analysis.scope_summary: NSWC IHD requires Secured Web Fingerprint Transmission (SWFT) fingerprint collection services for personnel requiring background investigations. The contractor must provide electronic fingerprint capture using Live Scan equipment at existing contractor locations nationwide. Services must comply with OPM standards and DCSA SWFT requirements, with capacity to process up to 900 personnel per year across a 5-year contract period.
